metadata.title: Frustration as the Specification: The High-Signal Debugging Model

viewpoint.mental_model: Observability-Driven Development (ODD). If you can't measure the slop, you can't fix it.

viewpoint.core_critique: The "Tangled Spaghetti" wall. Projects fail when the AI can't navigate the mess it built.

viewpoint.core_realization: Emotional friction (frustration) is the most honest metric for system failure.
viewpoint.scar: Three-hour loop trying to explain a UI bug until I realized I hadn't defined the CSS contract.

tech_brief.aha_moment: Stop treating frustration as a mood to be managed. Treat it as a **Technical Signal**. Every time you are annoyed by an AI's output, it means a **Specification** is missing. Deconstruct the emotion into a hard constraint (an Eval).

structure_beats.beat: The 3-Month Wall: Why vibe coding eventually dies.
The Signal: Why "this sucks" is the most important data point in your terminal.
The Deconstruction: Turning emotional friction into hard constraints (IBM Loop: Observe -> Perceive).
